_comment: Open roles. A role is only emitted as JobPosting structured data — the thing that makes it findable by a candidate's agent, Google Jobs, and LinkedIn — when "published": true. Everything in a published role is a public claim, so datePosted, location, and employmentType must be real. Run `npm run agents` after editing.

roles._why_unpublished: Scaffolded, not live. Flip to true once a partner confirms datePosted, location, employment type, and the application URL — an invalid or speculative JobPosting is worse than none.
roles.title: Support Partner
roles.description: A full-time operator embedded in a shuckerVC portfolio company, on shuckerVC's W2, running finance, hiring, vendors, marketing, and reporting so the founders stay on product and customers. Hired, trained, and managed by the shuckerVC GPs, with a specialist bench on call.
